items.title: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
items.snippet: Tether-backed Orionx is permanently closing after an audit found more than $7 million in customer assets had moved to wallets outside its custody.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо ETH -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
